stories.title: Facebook gives users new controls over Feed and Reels recommendations
paragraphs: Meta says Facebook users can now use an AI-powered feature called Your algorithm to add and manage topics they want to see in Feed and Reels. It also says users can explain in their own words why they want more or less of something.

Meta says recommendations will respond in real time, combining that input with existing ranking signals. The company has not shared adoption figures or measured how the controls may change creators’ distribution.

scoreNotes.general: A direct change to a large platform’s recommendation system could affect how creators reach audiences, although Meta has not quantified creator-side effects.
scoreNotes.heat: Meta is changing the controls for recommendations across Feed and Reels, a consequential distribution surface, but the announcement provides no adoption or reach data.
scoreNotes.time: Meta announced the feature on October 13, within the collection window.
scoreNotes.ethos: Meta’s newsroom describes the new controls and the role of its ranking systems; practical effects on creator reach remain unmeasured.

citations.title: Your Algorithm, Your Words: New Ways to Shape What You See on Facebook

stories.title: Battlefield 6 begins its Las Vegas season with two maps and a new mode
paragraphs: Battlefield 6’s Season 5, Siege of Vegas, began October 13. EA’s roadmap says the launch adds the Vegas Strip and Area 51 maps, the Rapid Royale mode, and a new arsenal; another map is planned later in the season.
The launch also removes Gauntlet from the game. Owl covered the season announcement on October 8, so this is the release of that planned content rather than a new season reveal.
EA has not reported player response in the checked material.

scoreNotes.general: The season’s launch turns an earlier roadmap into a substantial new content drop for a major live-service shooter.
scoreNotes.heat: Two maps, a new mode, and the removal of Gauntlet make this a meaningful game update; the roadmap gives no player-response figures.
scoreNotes.time: Season 5 began October 13, after Owl’s October 8 preview of the planned season.
scoreNotes.ethos: EA’s roadmap confirms the launch date and named content. Player reception and performance are not yet established by this source.

stories.title: Streamer StRoGo sets a personal Twitch audience record
paragraphs: Streamer Times reports that StRoGo drew 109,176 concurrent viewers on Friday, a personal 90-day high about 10% above the previous mark. The tracker says the result moved StRoGo from 41st to 23rd in its most-watched ranking.

The same weekly recap lists other streamer records and audience gains, but the StRoGo peak is the clearest single breakout. These are Streamer Times’ tracking figures; the source does not establish a platform-wide trend.

scoreNotes.general: A sharp breakout for a gaming streamer is a useful audience signal, while the available figures come from one independent tracker.
scoreNotes.heat: Streamer Times reports a 109,176-viewer peak and a personal 90-day best, moving StRoGo up its weekly ranking; this is a notable individual event, not platform-wide evidence.
scoreNotes.time: The peak occurred Friday during the October 5–11 week, and the recap was published October 12, inside the seven-day fallback range.
scoreNotes.ethos: The dated tracker gives the peak and comparison with the prior 90-day best. Twitch did not publish a corroborating statement in the checked material.

paragraphs: Solo developer Kate, publishing as Galactic Ghosty, and Iceberg Interactive released Allogloom on PC October 13. The hand-painted point-and-click adventure follows Nora through a town of unusual residents and lore-based puzzles.
The publisher describes an eight-chapter story across six worlds. This research found no independent audience measure or substantial public reaction yet.

scoreNotes.general: The large event remains useful creator-economy context, but the saved report is unchanged since Owl’s earlier coverage.
scoreNotes.heat: Streams Charts reports 28.79 million viewing hours across 312 channels and a combined peak above one million; these are one analytics outlet’s estimates.

paragraphs: Streams Charts reported that Dedsafio 4, a Spanish-language Minecraft survival competition organized by streamer ElDed, generated 28.79 million viewing hours across 312 participating Kick channels in its first 14 days.
The same report estimated a synchronized peak of about 1.07 million viewers. Owl already covered these figures earlier today, and no new result surfaced in this research.

scoreNotes.general: The closure has concrete consequences for players, but its announcement has already been covered and remains unchanged.
scoreNotes.heat: Ending a live mobile game is consequential, although no public player or revenue figure explains the decision.
scoreNotes.time: Ubisoft’s announcement is dated October 8; no newer service change surfaced.

paragraphs: Ubisoft says Rainbow Six Mobile will remain available until January 15, 2027, and that its next season will launch as planned. The team says it will move to other long-term projects.
The company has not given a reason or player-count figure in the checked message. Owl covered the shutdown earlier today, and this search found no meaningful change.
